{{Quote|&hellip;Tam, Lio&hellip;|Skirata and Vau mention Lio in their mourning|<ref name="Order 66" />}}
A [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] named '''Lio''' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="Order 66" /> of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="Dates" /> against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At some point during the war, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] and later mourned by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] [[Kal Skirata]] and [[Walon Vau]].<ref name="Order 66" /> A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Lio stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Clone Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> The trooper was created by [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] cloners on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Clone Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lio was mentioned in ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Karen Traviss]] as the fourth installment of the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel series.<ref name="Order 66" />
